title: English Conversation 9:  Busy Busy Busy
content: 1. What's going on?: What's happening? - Kathy and Karen are fighting. What's going on? - Everyone looks worried. What's going on? 2. due + (time): used to show a deadline when some work or something must be completed by - This report is due next Friday. - I have a project due tomorrow, so I can't go out tonight. 3. A person better + (verb): a grammar point used to give strong advice (stronger than "should") - We better go in now. It looks like it is going to rain. - You have a test in 2 days. You better start studying now.
